summary: The pattern closes the confused-authority gap between content the agent may inspect and instructions the system may obey.

points.text: OWASP identifies the absence of a clear instruction/data boundary as a root condition for prompt injection and combines separation with least privilege and independent tool-call validation.
Provenance must survive retrieval, extraction and summarization. A trusted summarizer does not make attacker-controlled claims authoritative.
The enforceable control is outside the model: content may influence a proposal, but only host policy can grant a capability or approve a side effect.
